allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Self-review REDs: closure after unavailable durable write, tracker-only closure after rejection, lost verification discriminator/basis on cap and ready reentry. Report claims final GREEN.
allReviewedPassages.rawText:
Self-review added and observed three further RED regressions before their fixes. Each used the same replay command/environment with the indicated output file:

```text
persistence-red.txt:
[FAIL] unavailable durable verification write prevents tracker closure
2054 passed, 1 failed

rejection-red.txt:
[FAIL] tracker closure alone cannot replace rejected verification acceptance
2056 passed, 1 failed

cap-red.txt:
[FAIL] oversized basis preserves cap/source pointer and verification completion discriminator
[FAIL] typed completion with compacted-away basis remains an evidence gap rather than an inferred landing
[FAIL] ready reentry with missing basis obtains independent verification review before closure
2059 passed, 3 failed
```

Final GREEN covers every one. Example failing values for the assertions are a commit-nudge/merge dispatch on the accepted unchanged task; a completion despite null/CLEAN-with-wrong-tree/fallback-for-live review; a rewritten provenance location; a missing Recovery basis or lost verification token; a close dispatch after failed append; a task landing count of 1 instead of 0; or a completed bucket populated only by tracker closure after review rejection. The fixtures check real coordinator routing, emitted prompts, result/ledger contents and the actual digest output, rather than asserting canned reply shapes against themselves.

Resolved each conflict preserving the verification-only result discriminator, independent source/evidence review, typed digest/resume evidence gaps, failureAttribution schema, durable introducing-owner/contradiction history, and resumed admission/Finish hold gates. allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Combined pending-closure reconciler wrongly required Git landing for verification-only record; sourceVerified branch and confirmed typed completion writes claimed.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: The combined code exposed an additional seam: the landed pending-closure reconciler required a Git landing head, which a verification-only record intentionally lacks. Its additive verification branch now resolves the retained unchanged commit/tree and observes all associated tracker statuses through `sourceVerified`; it never manufactures a landing or increments merge counts. Unavailable, mismatched or contradictory facts hold recovery even when a later tracker response claims closure. Verification closure now appends its clear and typed completion with structured `appended: true` confirmation before reducing the obligation or settling completed; failed writes retain the accepted basis and hold recovery. Cleanup observations preserve additive existing Recovery fields and evidence. Existing implementation landing reconciliation and regression classification remain intact.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Seam assertions and counterexamples, not new production findings.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: Added focused seam assertions for verification source/tracker recovery, already-closed verification recovery, and null/false closure append results. Values that fail these assertions include a missing sourceVerified observation, a fabricated already-merged prompt, a completion after failed append, a discarded accepted basis, or a merge count above zero. The existing recovered verification fixture now supplies the required explicit read-only source/tracker observation instead of assuming it. No assertion was deleted or weakened.

allReviewedPassages.rawText: Replay exercises all internal callers of the additive queueLedger/flushLedger confirmation option, confirmClosure, and resumeCheckPrompt; an rg call-site search found no callers outside coordinator.js. Dispatch and digest suites cover the ordinary execution/evidence transport and typed durable reduction. These remain deterministic fixtures, not fresh-agent behavior evals. Parent-owned no-change/implementation behavior evaluation remains unchanged. `git diff --check` passed, rebase completed successfully, and final `git status --short` was empty. The rebase continuation committed the tested bytes without changing them.
